AUDIENS PERSONA & PSIKOLOGI: Pecinta tanaman hias, penghobi urban farming, pekebun hidroponik/tanah organik, dan petani regeneratif. Konten ini memicu disonansi kognitif instan ("Tanaman saya... karnivora?!"), membongkar rasa penasaran mendalam mengenai apa yang sebenarnya terjadi saat mereka menyiram pupuk organik atau *compost tea*.
STRATEGI HOOK (0-3 DETIK): Membuka video dengan statemen kontraintuitif tajam ("Think your organic garden is strictly vegan? Stop!") disertai visual dramatis sel akar tanaman yang menyergap bakteri hidup. Menghentikan scroll dengan mematahkan asumsi paling mendasar tentang biologi tumbuhan.
ALUR KONTEN PAS/AIDA:
- Attention (Scene 1–2): Mengguncang persepsi umum bahwa tanaman hanya meminum air dan pupuk mineral cair.
- Interest (Scene 3–6): Memperkenalkan *Rhizophagy Cycle* yang divalidasi oleh Rutgers University—menampilkan proses biologis di mana sel akar menyedot dan melucuti bakteri hidup dengan superoksida.
- Desire (Scene 7–11): Menjelaskan mengapa fenomena ini menjadi kunci tanaman organik tumbuh lebat dan tahan penyakit—membuat penonton ingin langsung memeriksa dan mengoptimalkan mikrobioma akar mereka.
- Action (Scene 12–13): Ajakan kontekstual untuk like, share, subscribe, membaca panduan riset di blog Organictopia, serta pertanyaan terbuka pemicu debat di kolom komentar.

[PLATFORM: YOUTUBE]
DESKRIPSI: Think your organic vegetables and houseplants are strictly vegan? Prepare for an absolute botanical paradigm shift! In 2018, groundbreaking research led by Dr. James F. White at Rutgers University (published in the journal Microorganisms) discovered the Rhizophagy Cycle—proving that plant root tips actively trap, engulf, and extract nutrients from living soil bacteria. 

In this video, Organictopia breaks down the university-backed science behind how plant roots secrete sweet carbohydrate exudates to lure beneficial bacteria (like Bacillus and Pseudomonas), engulf them into root cells, strip their cell walls using reactive oxygen superoxide to harvest nitrogen, and then expel the survivors through elongating root hairs to repeat the cycle. If you brew compost tea or use organic mulch, you aren't just fertilizing soil—you are feeding live prey to your root cells!

Read the complete peer-reviewed study breakdown on our research blog: https://organictopia.net/rhizophagy-guide

```html
<script>
  // Master GSAP Timeline across all 13 scenes (Exact 90 Seconds Duration)
  const tl = gsap.timeline({ repeat: -1 });

  // Progress Bar Animation
  tl.to("#timeline-bar", { width: "100%", duration: 90, ease: "none" }, 0);

  // Background Ambient Movement
  gsap.to("#bgGlow", {
    x: 100,
    y: 50,
    scale: 1.15,
    duration: 6,
    repeat: -1,
    yoyo: true,
    ease: "sine.inOut"
  });

  // ================= SCENE TRANSITIONS (13 SCENES = 90 SECONDS) =================
  // Durations: Scene 1–12 = 7s each (84s), Scene 13 = 6s. Total = 90.0s.

  // --- SCENE 1 (0s -> 7s) ---
  tl.set("#s1", { opacity: 1, pointerEvents: "auto" }, 0);
  tl.fromTo("#s1 .headline-main", { y: 60, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.8, ease: "power3.out" }, 0.2);
  tl.fromTo("#s1-danger-pulse", { scale: 0.8, opacity: 0.3 }, { scale: 1.6, opacity: 0.9, repeat: 5, yoyo: true, duration: 0.6 }, 0.5);
  tl.fromTo("#world", { scale: 1 }, { scale: 1.05, duration: 6.8, ease: "power1.inOut" }, 0);
  tl.to("#s1", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.in" }, 6.5);

  // --- SCENE 2 (7s -> 14s) ---
  tl.set("#s2", { opacity: 1 }, 7.0);
  tl.fromTo("#s2 .headline-main", { y: 60, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.8, ease: "power3.out" }, 7.2);
  tl.to("#s2-bugs ellipse", { x: "random(-20, 20)", y: "random(-30, 30)", duration: 2, repeat: 2, yoyo: true, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 7.2);
  tl.to("#world", { y: -80, duration: 6.8, ease: "power2.inOut" }, 7.0);
  tl.to("#s2", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5 }, 13.5);

  // --- SCENE 3 (14s -> 21s) ---
  tl.set("#s3", { opacity: 1 }, 14.0);
  tl.fromTo("#s3 svg", { scale: 0.85, opacity: 0 }, { scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: 0.9, ease: "back.out(1.4)" }, 14.2);
  tl.to("#world", { y: 0, scale: 1, duration: 6.8, ease: "power1.out" }, 14.0);
  tl.to("#s3", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5 }, 20.5);

  // --- SCENE 4 (21s -> 28s) ---
  tl.set("#s4", { opacity: 1 }, 21.0);
  tl.fromTo("#s4 .headline-main", { y: 50, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.7 }, 21.2);
  tl.fromTo("#s4-drop1, #s4-drop2, #s4-drop3", { y: -30, opacity: 0 }, { y: 20, opacity: 1, stagger: 0.2, duration: 1.2, repeat: 3, yoyo: true }, 21.5);
  tl.to("#world", { scale: 1.08, duration: 6.8, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 21.0);
  tl.to("#s4", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5 }, 27.5);

  // --- SCENE 5 (28s -> 35s) ---
  tl.set("#s5", { opacity: 1 }, 28.0);
  tl.fromTo("#s5-bug", { scale: 1.6, opacity: 0.5 }, { scale: 0.7, opacity: 1, duration: 1.5, ease: "power3.inOut" }, 28.5);
  tl.to("#world", { rotation: 4, duration: 6.8, ease: "power1.inOut" }, 28.0);
  tl.to("#s5", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5 }, 34.5);

  // --- SCENE 6 (35s -> 42s) ---
  tl.set("#s6", { opacity: 1 }, 35.0);
  tl.fromTo("#s6-ring1, #s6-ring2", { rotation: 0, scale: 0.8 }, { rotation: 360, scale: 1.2, duration: 2.5, repeat: 2, ease: "none" }, 35.2);
  tl.to("#s6-core", { fill: "#f87171", duration: 1, repeat: 3, yoyo: true }, 35.5);
  tl.to("#world", { rotation: 0, scale: 1.15, duration: 6.8, ease: "power2.out" }, 35.0);
  tl.to("#s6", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5 }, 41.5);

  // --- SCENE 7 (42s -> 49s) ---
  tl.set("#s7", { opacity: 1 }, 42.0);
  tl.fromTo("#s7-ions circle", { y: 60, opacity: 0 }, { y: -80, opacity: 1, stagger: 0.25, duration: 1.4, repeat: 3, ease: "power2.out" }, 42.3);
  tl.to("#world", { x: 50, duration: 6.8, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 42.0);
  tl.to("#s7", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5 }, 48.5);

  // --- SCENE 8 (49s -> 56s) ---
  tl.set("#s8", { opacity: 1 }, 49.0);
  tl.fromTo("#s8-hair", { strokeDashoffset: 200, strokeDasharray: 200 }, { strokeDashoffset: 0, duration: 1.5, ease: "power3.out" }, 49.3);
  tl.fromTo("#s8-shot-bug", { x: 0, opacity: 0 }, { x: 90, opacity: 1, duration: 1, repeat: 3, ease: "power2.out" }, 50.0);
  tl.to("#world", { x: -40, duration: 6.8, ease: "power1.inOut" }, 49.0);
  tl.to("#s8", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5 }, 55.5);

  // --- SCENE 9 (56s -> 63s) ---
  tl.set("#s9", { opacity: 1 }, 56.0);
  tl.to("#s9-loop", { rotation: 360, transformOrigin: "center center", duration: 6, ease: "none" }, 56.2);
  tl.to("#world", { scale: 1, x: 0, duration: 6.8, ease: "power2.out" }, 56.0);
  tl.to("#s9", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5 }, 62.5);

  // --- SCENE 10 (63s -> 70s) ---
  tl.set("#s10", { opacity: 1 }, 63.0);
  tl.fromTo("#s10-spray line", { strokeDashoffset: 50, strokeDasharray: 50 }, { strokeDashoffset: 0, duration: 0.8, repeat: 5, ease: "none" }, 63.3);
  tl.to("#world", { y: -50, scale: 1.05, duration: 6.8, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 63.0);
  tl.to("#s10", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5 }, 69.5);

  // --- SCENE 11 (70s -> 77s) ---
  tl.set("#s11", { opacity: 1 }, 70.0);
  tl.fromTo("#s11 svg path", { strokeDashoffset: 300, strokeDasharray: 300 }, { strokeDashoffset: 0, stagger: 0.3, duration: 2, ease: "power3.out" }, 70.3);
  tl.to("#world", { y: 0, scale: 0.95, duration: 6.8, ease: "power2.out" }, 70.0);
  tl.to("#s11", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5 }, 76.5);

  // --- SCENE 12 (77s -> 84s) ---
  tl.set("#s12", { opacity: 1 }, 77.0);
  tl.fromTo("#s12 svg", { scale: 0.8 }, { scale: 1.1, repeat: 3, yoyo: true, duration: 0.9, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 77.3);
  tl.to("#world", { scale: 1, duration: 6.8, ease: "power1.out" }, 77.0);
  tl.to("#s12", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5 }, 83.5);

  // --- SCENE 13 (84s -> 90s) ---
  tl.set("#s13", { opacity: 1 }, 84.0);
  tl.fromTo("#s13 .headline-main", { scale: 0.9, opacity: 0 }, { scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: 0.7, ease: "back.out(1.2)" }, 84.2);
  tl.to("#world", { scale: 1, x: 0, y: 0, duration: 5.8, ease: "power2.inOut" }, 84.0);
  tl.to("#s13", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.4 }, 89.6);

  // Keyboard Navigation Controls
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.code === 'Space') {
      e.preventDefault();
      tl.paused(!tl.paused());
    }
    if (e.code === 'KeyR') {
      tl.restart();
    }
  });
</script>
</body>
</html>
```
